class.name: DSErrorHandler
class.brief_description: Asynchronous error bridge for DirectStorage kernel events.
class.description: [DSErrorHandler] stores asynchronous DirectStorage diagnostics and routes native failures to Godot's Output panel. The extension registers it as the [Engine] singleton named [code]"DSErrorHandler"[/code]. Queue monitoring is available on Windows builds; [method describe_hresult] and [method describe_command_type] can also translate known DirectStorage HRESULT values and command types on any build.

method.name: clear_error
method.description: Clears the last recorded error state.

method.name: describe_command_type
method.description: Returns a readable description for a DirectStorage failure command type (such as [code]"NONE"[/code], [code]"REQUEST"[/code], [code]"STATUS"[/code], [code]"SIGNAL"[/code], or [code]"EVENT"[/code]).

method.name: describe_hresult
method.description: Returns a readable description for a known DirectStorage or system HRESULT. Returns an empty string when the code is not recognized.

method.name: get_last_error
method.description: Returns the string description of the last asynchronous DirectStorage failure.

method.name: has_error
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if an asynchronous error has been flagged.

method.name: process_queue_errors
method.description: Retrieves and reports pending DirectStorage queue failures across all registered priority queues. This method is available only on Windows builds and is normally called by the native backend.

method.name: report_error
method.description: Manually flags and reports an error message to the error handler.
